---
title: "Massachusetts Income"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
---


**Median Income**
```{r}
library(tidycensus)
library(tidyverse)

mass_income <- get_acs(
  geography = "county",
  variables = "B19013_001",
  state = "MA",
  year = 2022,
  survey = "acs5",
  output = "wide",
  load = TRUE
) |>
  rename(
    county = NAME,
    income = B19013_001E,
    moe = B19013_001M
  )

# Now this will work
mass_income |>
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(county, income), y = income)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  coord_flip()


```

**Median Income by Confidence Interval**
```{r}
library(tidyverse)   # loads ggplot2, dplyr, etc.
library(tidycensus)
mass_income |>
  ggplot(aes(x = income, y = fct_reorder(county, income))) +
  geom_point(color = "#1B9E77", size = 3) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = income - moe, xmax = income + moe), height = 0.3, color = "gray50") +
  labs(
    title = "Median Income with Confidence Intervals (MOE)",
    x = "Median Income (USD)",
    y = "County"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::dollar_format()) +
  theme_light(base_size = 14)

```

**Countries Fluctuated Income**
```{r}
library(tidyverse)   # loads ggplot2, dplyr, etc.
library(tidycensus)
# Compute overall state median
state_median <- median(mass_income$income)

mass_income |>
  mutate(status = if_else(income >= state_median, "Above Median", "Below Median")) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(county, income), y = income, fill = status)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Counties Above vs Below Statewide Median Income",
    x = "",
    y = "Median Income (USD)"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Above Median" = "#4CAF50", "Below Median" = "#F44336")) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::dollar_format()) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

```
